market_timing.market_start: exact Gamma BTC 5m market start T
market_timing.late_prediction_policy: retain actual ready time; never backdate or substitute a later row; late signal is ineligible

collection.mode: public GET and public Binance WebSocket only; no order methods or authenticated trading client
collection.settlement_source: official Gamma market payload after resolution

runtime.commit_frequency: each received or REST-repaired candle; each completed market attempt and outcome
runtime.checkpoint_identity: candidate model/transform hashes, feature order, protocol, runner and runtime-source hashes
runtime.on_size_limit: stop and record; do not delete research data
runtime.log_rotation: SQLite collector_events retained in the research database; WAL checkpoint/truncate hourly; no automatic database rotation or deletion

estimated_storage_gb_per_day.basis: capacity estimate for 1,152 full-depth token snapshots/day (288 markets x 2 times x 2 tokens), raw minute provenance and SQLite overhead; replace with measured bytes after reachable live pilot

precision_plan.outcome_unit: net PnL per $5 gross order; no-trade contributes zero

primary_comparisons.A_vs_cash: frozen A decision result versus zero PnL
primary_comparisons.D_vs_B: paired difference in frozen D and B decision results on the same market window

precision_plan.familywise_correction: Bonferroni across A-versus-cash and D-versus-B; per-test alpha 0.025
precision_plan.sample_size_formula: ((z_0.9875 + z_0.80) * sigma / MDE)^2; inflate for three-day block dependence using DE=1+(m-1)*rho
precision_plan.final_look: one fixed analysis at the first complete UTC day after both dependence-adjusted transaction thresholds and the calendar threshold are met; never stop on interim economic signs
